name: claude-switch
description: Use several Claude accounts on one Mac: live usage for every account, move Claude Desktop sessions between accounts, and switch the Claude Code CLI login automatically.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cs && codesign --force --sign - --identifier app.claude-switch.cli dist/cs
scripts.install:local: bun run build && bun run build:app && ./dist/cs install --app "dist/Accounts Manager for Claude.app"
